snippet.title: Keycap Keycap! | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5082580?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

Enjoy the satisfying click of every keycap! Collect a variety of keycaps, upgrade your skills, and acquire powerful Relic Keycaps. 
Keycap Keycap! is a short and satisfying incremental ASMR game.
